title: Strong Navier–Stokes–Fourier limits and fluid-lifespan lower bounds for well-prepared hard-cutoff Boltzmann fluctuations on two- and three-dimensional tori
author: Isabelle Gallagher; Isabelle Tristani
work: On the convergence of smooth solutions from Boltzmann to Navier–Stokes
source_version: Annales Henri Lebesgue 3 (2020), publisher version, DOI 10.5802/ahl.40

primary_locator.proof_scope: complete Sections 2--4 and author spectral/technical appendices

difficulty_reason: The authors filter the nonlinear error by an exponential depending on a possibly large fluid solution, prove a uniform contraction using microscopic spectral damping and macroscopic time-integrated estimates, and show vanishing nonlinear acoustic remainder by integration in time. This fluid-lifespan kinetic singular-limit construction exceeds ordinary qualifying examinations.
